declaration:
# the ceiling over 4 streams: unpaced explicit batches from four callers per stream, two groups on every stream

[input]
stream        orders-1         DeliveryLogMode all
consumers     fraud-scoring    handler fail rate 0, 3 retries then dead, batch 2000, queue 8000, concurrency 4, idle poll 100ms
consumers     analytics        handler fail rate 0, 3 retries then dead, batch 2000, queue 8000, concurrency 4, idle poll 100ms
stream        orders-2         DeliveryLogMode all
consumers     fraud-scoring    handler fail rate 0, 3 retries then dead, batch 2000, queue 8000, concurrency 4, idle poll 100ms
consumers     analytics        handler fail rate 0, 3 retries then dead, batch 2000, queue 8000, concurrency 4, idle poll 100ms
stream        orders-3         DeliveryLogMode all
consumers     fraud-scoring    handler fail rate 0, 3 retries then dead, batch 2000, queue 8000, concurrency 4, idle poll 100ms
consumers     analytics        handler fail rate 0, 3 retries then dead, batch 2000, queue 8000, concurrency 4, idle poll 100ms
stream        orders-4         DeliveryLogMode all
consumers     fraud-scoring    handler fail rate 0, 3 retries then dead, batch 2000, queue 8000, concurrency 4, idle poll 100ms
consumers     analytics        handler fail rate 0, 3 retries then dead, batch 2000, queue 8000, concurrency 4, idle poll 100ms
producer      batch concurrency 4 per stream
recording     per-message disabled; aggregate counters only
exceptions    disabled
producer      explicit batching true, concurrent callers 4
workload      automatic batching false, payload bytes 1000, pool max 64, batch size 250
duration      150s

[shape]
warm:    warmup unpaced per stream 30s
hold:    unpaced per stream 2m

at 0m    consumers 2

[expect]
lost                  0
unexpected            0
recovered             report
undelivered           0
duplicates            report
unbucketed            0
reclaims              report
dead                  0
backlog_bounded       report
generator_headroom    report
errors                0
